The iPad Mini Killer is finally here. Yes, the OPPO Pad Mini is launched in India. The price of OPPO Pad Mini in India is ₹94,999 with 8GB RAM and 256GB Storage. For the price, it's bringing some solid specs. The display is a 2.5K 144Hz OLED panel with matte coating, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 8,000mAh battery, 67W charging, and a super smooth software experience with ColorOS 16. In this video, we compare the OPPO Pad Mini with the iPad Mini to find out which is the best compact tablet you can buy in India. Watch the video fully to know everything.
